lines.text: Jesus left Galilee for Judea beyond the Jordan, where large crowds followed Him and He healed them.
Pharisees tested Jesus about divorce, and He pointed to the Creator making them male and female, so man must not separate them.
The Pharisees asked why Moses ordered a certificate of divorce, and Jesus said Moses permitted it because of hardness of heart.
The disciples said it is better not to marry, and Jesus said some live like eunuchs for the sake of the temple in Jerusalem.
The disciples rebuked those bringing children, but Jesus said the kingdom of heaven belongs to those who teach them.
